name: postUrl
label: Post URL
help: The LinkedIn post URL to comment on. Provide this or the post URN.

name: postUrn
label: Post URN
help: URN of the post, accepted instead of the post URL. For example, urn:li:activity:1234567890123456789.

name: commentText
label: Comment Text
help: Comment text, must be up to 1000 characters

name: companyUrl
label: Company URL
help: LinkedIn company page URL. If specified, the comment will be added on behalf of the company page.
